question: What condition affects even the wise person at the tip of nectar with its essence?
premises: The location is the tip of nectar
The essence of juice is involved
Even a wise person is burning
inference: Even the wise person is burning at the tip of nectar by the essence of its juice.
uncertainties: The physiological or yogic referent of amṛta+agraṃ is not explicit in this verse alone.
plain_english: Even the wise person burns at the tip of nectar by the essence of its juice.
